findings.desc: METR blockquote: the four hollow-circle (○) sub-bullets nested under '[Claude Mythos 5.2] substantially improves upon Fable 5.1…' ('In particular, the primary way…', 'Note that we think it is plausible…') and under 'Anthropic reports that [Claude Mythos 5.2] does better…' ('…“solves a clear majority…”', '…also “nearly saturates…”', 'And, outside of evals, “completed several…”') escape the blockquote and lose nesting: md emits them as unquoted top-level '- ' lists between quote fragments, so the served page closes the <blockquote>, renders a plain top-level <ul>, reopens a new <blockquote> for 'Anthropic reports…', then another plain <ul>. PDF shows one continuous left-ruled quote with a 2-level list (● items with ○ children).

p-040.png (○ sub-bullets indented under ● items, inside the left rule) vs sections/02-rsp-evaluations.md lines 394-403 (lines 396-397 and 401-403 lack '> ' and are not indented) and served.html '
